The History And The Future Of Cloud Office Suites

# The History And The Future Of Cloud Office Suites

By Vince Marino,

Forbes Councils Member.

Oct 26, 2020, 09:10am EDT

Co-Founder at Afi.ai, a developer of the leading SaaS backup platform built from the ground-up to protect cloud applications.

getty

An office suite is a set of productivity applications that typically include email, file sharing, document editing and collaborative tools. Most office workers use office suites daily, and the work-from-home transition has made these tools a critical component of the work environment. In fact, some of the most prestigious professions — management consulting, investor relations, finance and banking — are focused almost exclusively on making PowerPoint slide decks, crunching Excel spreadsheets and exchanging email messages.
